svg.text: Design v2: white roads with the condition on the casing, Car friendly in its own colour, lighter main roads
Julien, 2026-11-20. High vis 2 widths (1.5 x), z15, proposed land. Pick a Car friendly colour (section 1) and a main-road fill strength (section 2).
Minor ways: condition on the casing or edges
edges: grey paved, colour car friendly; solid brown, near black
Main roads: darker shade of the class colour on lighter fills
